channel.title: Golnaz.RoughCut
channel.description: Golnaz Alibeigi's blog on video production, developer media, and storytelling. Head of DevRel Studios at Microsoft.

item.title: AI Raised the Bar (And Now We're All Tired)
item.description: Fifteen years ago, post-event video uploads took two weeks. Now we ship in 24 hours with chapters, thumbnails, and metadata. AI made that possible. AI fatigue is the price.

item.title: If You Didn't Capture It, Did It Really Happen?
item.description: Why every event with budget should capture sessions for on-demand. In-person reaches thousands, digital reaches hundreds of thousands. Don't leave that opportunity on the table.

item.title: AI Didn't Kill Video Editing (It Made Some Nice Motion Graphics)
item.description: A video claims Claude destroyed every video editing tool. But what it showed isn't editing—it's motion graphics. Here's why AI still analyzes audio, not video, and what that means for the craft.

item.title: Livestreaming Before It Was Cool
item.description: From the Spinnaker to YouTube Live. How streaming works, the professional tiers from Ross to OBS, and why live beats polished video.

item.title: Copilot CLI vs VS Code: When I Use Each
item.description: How I split my AI coding workflow between Copilot CLI for quick questions and GitHub Copilot in VS Code for project-heavy work, plus MCP servers and skills I've built along the way.

item.title: NDI Tools: The Unsung Hero of Video Production
item.description: NDI quietly revolutionized how we move video around the studio. Free tools, zero hype, massive impact. Here's why it deserves more love.

item.title: Kill Your Ego, Ship Your Work
item.description: The best producers aren't the most technically skilled. They're the ones who can read a room, give credit freely, and get out of their own way.

item.title: I Spent $50 on AI Video Generation and Got Nothing Usable
item.description: An honest review of Runway, Sora 2 in Azure Foundry, and Pollo.ai for real video production work. The flow state problem with tokenized AI tools.

item.title: Active vs Archival Storage: How We Store Petabytes on Pennies
item.description: Video production storage strategy using Azure File Sync and Frame.io. Moving from expensive SNS EVO to cloud tiering that costs pennies on the dollar.

item.title: What Came First: The Content or the Platform?
item.description: How platforms shape content and content shapes platforms. Lessons from Channel 9, YouTube's AI evolution, and deciding whether to build or borrow.

item.title: How a Creative Team Learned to Love Azure DevOps
item.description: Using Azure DevOps and Power Automate to manage a video production team. Automation, transparency, and even GPT-powered workback schedules.

item.title: The Art of the Oner
item.description: The magic of the one-shot take from Children of Men to corporate keynotes. Why oners work, famous examples, and why you see them at tech events.

item.title: What AI Has (and Hasn't) Taken Over in Video Production
item.description: A look at what AI has actually changed in video production—captions, voice, audio cleanup—and what's still waiting for someone to build.

item.title: Year 15: Why I'm Finally Hitting Publish
item.description: After 15 years at Microsoft producing thousands of developer videos, I'm finally writing it down. Why I started this blog, what RoughCut means, and what's coming next.
